name: generate_image
description: Generate an image using the provider configured in Settings and return an in-chat preview artifact. First decide whether the user supplied a ready-to-run prompt or only a sparse visual intent. A prompt is ready when it is labeled or quoted as a prompt, requested exactly, or already specifies the important subject, scene or style, composition, literal text, or constraints. Copy every ready prompt byte-for-byte with prompt_mode=verbatim: never translate, correct, reorder, summarize, or append quality/style tokens. For sparse intent, author one concise production prompt using only relevant deliverable/use, subject/action, setting, medium/style, composition, lighting/color/mood, exact visible text, and constraints; do not invent brands, copy, identities, facts, or data, and use prompt_mode=agent_refined. Provider enhancement is opt-in and may only use provider_enhanced when the user requests enhancement or ideation. The tool does not save the image into the workspace; the user reviews the preview and chooses Save As.

prompt.description: The exact prompt Nexa submits. In verbatim mode copy the user's ready prompt byte-for-byte, including whitespace, punctuation, language, quoted text, weights, and provider syntax. In agent_refined mode write a compact visual brief from sparse intent without inventing high-impact content. Keep size, format, background, and negative prompt in their dedicated fields when available.

prompt_mode.description: Prompt provenance and rewrite policy. Omission defaults to verbatim for compatibility. verbatim means the user supplied a ready prompt and it must be copied byte-for-byte. agent_refined means the agent authored the prompt from sparse intent and provider-side rewriting must stay disabled. provider_enhanced is explicit opt-in to provider rewriting and is only allowed when the user requested enhancement or ideation.

prompt_extend.description: Deprecated compatibility input; do not use in new calls. When prompt_mode is omitted, true maps to provider_enhanced and false maps to verbatim. An explicit prompt_mode takes precedence.

provider.description: Optional provider override: openai, openai_compatible, xai, grok, google, gemini, nano_banana, qwen, dashscope, aliyun, or alibaba.

api_style.description: Optional API adapter override: openai_images, xai_images, gemini_generate_content, or dashscope_multimodal. xAI requires xai_images for its aspect_ratio, resolution and quality contract.

provider_config_id.description: Optional legacy saved LLM provider config id to use. Normally omit this; the tool defaults to Settings > Image generation.

model.description: Optional image model. Any model id supported by the selected API adapter is accepted. If omitted, the model configured in Settings > Image generation is used.

size.description: Optional output size. GPT Image 2.5 accepts auto or widthxheight (multiples of 16, max edge 3840, ratio 1:3 to 3:1, total 655360-8294400 pixels). xAI uses aspect ratio and resolution such as 16:9|2k. Google accepts 16:9|2K. Qwen accepts width*height with x converted to *.

quality.description: GPT Image supports auto, low, medium or high; gpt-image-2.5-flare and gpt-image-2.5-sunburst also support xhigh and max. grok-imagine-image-2.0 supports auto, low or medium. Omit for older Grok image models.

resolution.description: Optional xAI output resolution overriding the resolution in size.

output_compression.description: Optional GPT Image JPEG/WebP compression value. Omit for PNG and xAI.

background.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible background setting: auto, transparent, or opaque.

output_format.description: Optional image format preference: png, jpeg, or webp.

negative_prompt.description: Optional negative prompt, currently used by Qwen/DashScope.

watermark.description: Optional Qwen watermark flag. Defaults to false.

filename.description: Optional suggested filename shown if the user chooses Save As. Extension is inferred from output_format when missing.
